blogPosts.title: 5 Signs It's Time to Replace Your Phone Screen
blogPosts.description: A cracked screen isn't just a cosmetic issue. Here are the top signs that you should replace your screen for better performance and safety.
blogPosts.author: Auto Wirx Team
blogPosts.intro: A cracked screen isn't just a cosmetic issue. It can affect your phone's performance, safety and usability. If you're unsure whether it's time for a replacement, here are the top signs to look for.

contentBlocks.title: 1. Visible Cracks or Shattered Glass
contentBlocks.content: The most obvious sign is visible damage. Even small cracks can spread over time and make the screen more fragile. A shattered screen can also cause injury, so it's best to get it replaced as soon as possible.

contentBlocks.title: 2. Unresponsive Touchscreen
contentBlocks.content: If your screen doesn't respond to touch or you notice delayed response, it could be due to internal damage. This can make it difficult to use your phone and may get worse with time.

contentBlocks.title: 3. Display Issues
contentBlocks.content: Lines, flickering, dead pixels or black spots on your screen are clear indicators of screen damage. These issues can affect your viewing experience and may eventually make the screen unusable.

contentBlocks.title: 4. Discoloration or Dark Patches
contentBlocks.content: If you notice yellow spots, dark patches or uneven colors, it's a sign that your screen is compromised. This usually happens due to physical impact or pressure.

contentBlocks.title: 5. Glass Feeling Rough or Sharp
contentBlocks.content: If the glass surface feels rough or you can feel sharp edges, it's not safe to continue using the device. A replacement will restore the smooth and safe surface of your phone.

contentBlocks.content: The most obvious sign is visible damage. Even small cracks can spread over time and make the screen more fragile. A shattered screen can also cause injury, so it's best to get it replaced as soon as possible.

contentBlocks.title: 2. Unresponsive Touchscreen
contentBlocks.content: If your screen doesn't respond to touch or you notice delayed response, it could be due to internal damage. This can make it difficult to use your phone and may get worse with time.

contentBlocks.title: 3. Display Issues
contentBlocks.content: Lines, flickering, dead pixels or black spots on your screen are clear indicators of screen damage. These issues can affect your viewing experience and may eventually make the screen unusable.

contentBlocks.title: 4. Discoloration or Dark Patches
contentBlocks.content: If you notice yellow spots, dark patches or uneven colors, it's a sign that your screen is compromised. This usually happens due to physical impact or pressure.

contentBlocks.title: 5. Glass Feeling Rough or Sharp
contentBlocks.content: If the glass surface feels rough or you can feel sharp edges, it's not safe to continue using the device. A replacement will restore the smooth and safe surface of your phone.

faqs.question: How long does a typical repair take?
faqs.answer: Most repairs are completed within the same day, depending on the issue and device model. Some complex repairs may take a little longer, but we'll always keep you informed.

faqs.question: Do you use original parts?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use high-quality replacement parts that meet industry standards to ensure your device functions like new.

faqs.question: Will I lose my data after the repair?
faqs.answer: Normally, your personal data remains safe during standard hardware repairs like screen or battery replacements. However, we always recommend backing up your data before any service.

faqs.question: How much does a screen replacement cost?
faqs.answer: Screen replacement costs vary depending on your device brand and model. You can check our pricing table above or contact us for an exact quote.

faqs.question: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide a warranty on all our repairs and replaced parts to give you complete peace of mind.

faqs.question: Can you fix water damaged devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer specialized water damage diagnosis and repair services. Bring your device in as soon as possible to increase recovery chances.

faqs.question: Do I need to book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Appointments are not strictly required, but booking in advance helps us serve you faster and ensures priority support.

faqs.question: Which brands and models do you service?
faqs.answer: We service all major smartphone brands including Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Motorola, Google, and more.

faqs.question: How can I get a quote for my device?
faqs.answer: You can request a custom quote through our website form, call our support line, or visit our store directly.

faqs.question: Do you offer software support as well?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle software updates, bug fixes, lag issues, and operating system restorations.

faqs.question: What if my issue is not listed here?
faqs.answer: If your specific issue isn't listed, feel free to reach out to our team. We handle a wide variety of custom electronic repairs.
